text: Joomi mon, onon ɓee yimɓe, tagii on e fittaandu wooturu, ndun woni Aadama. Refti O tagi e makko, genndo makko on Hawaa. O tagani on gelooɗi e na'i e dammi e be'i, nooneeji jeetati, noone kala, gorel e deyel. Himo tagira on ka teege yumma mon en, sagara naɓi sagara, e nder niɓe reedu e rennga e jowtol. Ko On mooɗon tagoowo ɗum fow, woni Allah, Joomi mon. Ko Kanko laamu woodani. Reweteeɗo e goonga alaa, si wanaa Kanko. Ko honno ferlitoraɗon e rewugol ko tagataa, acca ɗon tagoowo On?
